entities.name: Joan Martí i Alanis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joan Martí i Alanis was a Spanish Catholic prelate who served as Bishop of Urgell and ex officio episcopal co-Prince of Andorra from 1971 to 2003. He was a co-signatory, along with François Mitterrand, of Andorra's new constitution in 1993.
